correctness.rationale: Equality of the endpoint norms makes every inequality in the source moment-duality chain an equality. The source measure for monotone weights has positive continuous mass above the mean, so the analytic coefficient defect vanishes identically. Schwarz-Pick equality makes f/g a degree-one Möbius function. After entire cancellation, the remaining factor h is forced constant because the exact norm difference has higher coefficients m_{j+1}-(m1/m0)m_j, all strictly positive by covariance of a nondegenerate positive random variable with its increasing powers. The converse linear family satisfies both domination and norm equality by exact identities.
